name: Voxel Interpolation (Nearest, Trilinear, Triquadratic, Tricubic)
definition: A templated class for sampling voxel grid values at integer coordinates (ijk) or floating-point coordinates (xyz). Supports interpolation orders 0 (nearest), 1 (trilinear), 2 (triquadratic), and 3 (tricubic).
summary: Voxel Interpolation samples voxel grids at arbitrary coordinates using templated APIs supporting orders zero through three, distinguishing itself by abstracting underlying tree structures while offering multiple precision levels and interpolation kernels.
